 Pelicans vs Clippers Prediction, Picks & Best Bet for Tonight's NBA Game
 Ed Scimia 
 • Betting Analyst 
 17+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Nov 8, 2026 , 02:00 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 Even at home, the Clippers aren't a formidable opponent with their depleted roster right now, and the Pelicans should win comfortably tonight.
 Jump to section: 
 Prediction 
 Combo 
 Player Props 
 Odds 
 nba
 Nov 08 • 4:00 PM ET 
 Photo By - Reuters Connect. Custom image of Dejounte Murray Rui Hachimura 
 The New Orleans Pelicans will try to start a new winning streak as they visit the Los Angeles Clippers tonight at 9 p.m. ET.
 Los Angeles has been among the NBA's worst teams on both sides of the ball, and I'm backing New Orleans to cover in my Pelicans vs. Clippers prediction and free  NBA picks for Sunday, Nov. 8.
  TOP PICK 
Pelicans vs Clippers prediction: Pelicans -1.5 
 The Los Angeles Clippers (1-7) have been one of the worst teams in the NBA this season and are 1-4 against the spread in their last five games. The Clippers rank 23rd in defensive efficiency (113.0) and have been even worse offensively, ranking 27th in offensive efficiency (104.3) . 
 That doesn't bode well against a New Orleans Pelicans team that recently strung together a four-game winning streak and will hound the Clippers' offense. The Pelicans force 17.4 turnovers per game , while Los Angeles averages a league-high 20.1 giveaways.
 Losing that many possessions will prevent the depleted Clippers from staying in this game, even at home. I like the Pelicans to cover at spreads up to -4.5 tonight .
 COVERS INTEL: The Clippers commit turnovers on 19.3% of their possessions , the second-highest rate in the NBA this season. 
 Enjoying Covers content? Add us as a preferred source on your Google account Pelicans vs Clippers combo
 The Pelicans are one of the fastest-paced teams in the NBA, leading them to average 120.2 points per game. And while the Clippers have some efficiency issues, they don't grind games to a halt. Los Angeles has gone Over tonight's total in each of its last four games, and I like them to do it again.
 With points on the board, I also like  Zion Williamson to hit his 20+ point target. Williamson is averaging 20.6 ppg and has scored 20+ in six of his nine games this season.
 Pelicans vs Clippers combo
 Pelicans -1.5
 Over 226.5
 Zion Williamson 20+ points
 Pelicans vs Clippers player props
 Pelicans player prop: Dejounte Murray 30+ points + rebounds + assists
 Dejounte Murray 's overall numbers (an average of 27.1 PRA) may not look promising, but two factors work in his favor. First, he's only played six games so far, and a poor showing on Friday night dragged his averages down. He's hit 30+ PRA in three of those six games overall.
 Second, this game promises to be fast-paced, with the Pelicans taking full advantage of a shaky Clippers defense and getting easy buckets off turnovers. That's enough of a boost for me to back Murray to get 30+ PRA at up to 52%.
Clippers player prop: Rui Hachimura 6+ rebounds
 The Clippers don't offer many exciting prop bet targets, but Rui Hachimura is one of the more dependable names on the roster. Hachimura is putting up 6.5 rebounds per game and has gone for 7+ boards in two straight. 
 The former Gonzaga standout shouldn't have much trouble repeating those numbers against a Pelicans team that isn't great on the glass, ranking 17th in the NBA with a 49.9% rebounding rate. This is a reasonable target for Hachimura, and I'm backing him to get 6+ rebounds at odds up to 50%.

 Betting Analyst 
 Ed Scimia has been writing about the gaming industry for over 15 years. He graduated from Syracuse University with degrees in Magazine Journalism and Political Science in 2003, and has covered major gambling events like the World Series of Poker in his career. Since joining Covers in 2022, Ed has offered his sports betting analysis primarily on MLB, NFL, college football, and college basketball games, but is willing to take on any sport.
 His betting strategy focuses more on finding line value based on deviations from the market rather than traditional handicapping, primarily shopping between DraftKings, FanDuel, and Fanatics in his home state of Connecticut, though he’s not afraid to do deep game analysis to find profitable bets at any book.
 Outside of gambling, Ed is an avid curler who competes in mixed doubles on the World Curling Tour and runs a popular curling YouTube channel, Chess on Ice. That experience has come in handy during the Olympics, when he has proven to be a successful curling bettor as well. 
 Ed's advice to new bettors is to always open multiple sportsbook accounts and check the odds at each before placing any bet. Successful sports betting is about consistently beating the closing line value, which requires finding spots where one book is offering odds far better than the rest of the market and jumping on those opportunities.
